title: Residency-aware event shipper and archival API for audit evidence
creator: Asha Menon
description: Implement a residency-aware event shipper and archival API that centralizes audit evidence delivery, enforces data residency and retention policies, and provides enriched event payloads for downstream reporting. Scope includes: 1) an HTTP-based archival API that accepts evidence bundles and returns signed manifests; 2) a webhook/event-shipping subsystem that enforces region constraints, at-least-once delivery with idempotency keys, and backpressure handling; 3) event enrichment pipeline to attach residency assertions, retention TTL, and provenance metadata; and 4) operational tooling (metrics, dead-letter queue, and a reconciliation job) to ensure evidence compliance and demonstrable audit trails.
acceptance_criteria: API accepts zipped evidence bundles with metadata and returns a signed manifest URL and artifact id
Event shipper routes outgoing webhook deliveries to region-constrained endpoints and never transfers artifacts outside declared residency region
Delivery semantics: at-least-once; duplicates detectable via idempotency-key header; retry policy documented and observable
Retention metadata applied at ingest; archival storage class and TTL exported in manifest and accessible via audit queries
End-to-end test with synthetic tenant in EU region proving no cross-region egress for EU-tagged evidence
Conformance tests for schema v1 and automated compatibility checks for future schema versions

api_contract: POST /v1/archival-bundles - accepts multipart/form-data: bundle.zip (binary), metadata.json (string) headers: X-Tenant-ID, X-Residency-Region, Idempotency-Key
Headers for webhooks: X-Redwood-Signature (HMAC-SHA256), X-Redwood-Delivery-Attempt (int), X-Redwood-Idempotency-Key
test_plan: Unit tests for manifest signing and verification
Integration test: synthetic tenant with residency=eu-west-1; upload bundle; assert manifest region and that exported manifest URL is in the same region
Chaos test: simulate upstream webhook endpoint flapping; validate retry/backoff and eventual DLQ contents
Compatibility test: send schema v1 and v0.9 payloads and assert graceful rejection with clear error code
Performance test: validate archival API sustains 500 small-bundle requests/minute in the Hosted environment
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (internal): Deploy shipper and archival API to staging; enable for internal compliance tenants only
Phase 2 (limited customers): Enable for 3 pilot customers with EU residency requirement; collect metrics and adjust retry thresholds
Phase 3 (general): Gradual opt-in via Console toggle; default to off for existing tenants until opt-in confirmed
Fallback: Fallback to region-compatible manifest generation; if storage disabled in tenant region, notify compliance and pause deliveries
risks: Misconfigured storage region may cause accidental cross-region egress
High retry volume could overwhelm customer endpoints or cause billing spikes if not rate-limited
Complexity of idempotency across multiple replicas could yield duplicate deliveries if ledger races occur
mitigations: Enforce storage region checks at ingest and fail fast with actionable error message
Rate-limit webhook deliveries per-tenant and provide exponential backoff with jitter; surface metrics in Console
Use a strongly consistent delivery ledger (single-region write or consensus) and include sequence numbers in delivery records to detect out-of-order retries
